Hi {!Lead.FirstName}, Have you ever wanted to know how to handle those insurance sales objections your team has the most trouble overcoming? Join us Wednesday, April 15, 2020 @ 2:00 PM Eastern to find out how in this webinar "Insurance Lead Objections: Controlling the Conversation" featuring successful agent, speaker and author, Kirk Fuqua (and hosted by Chandler Hahn). Learn how to prepare yourself (and your producers) to deal with a range of objections that you’ll hear when working insurance leads.
Kirk opened his first insurance agency in 2008 as a captive agent and grew it to be one of the largest in the country (later transitioning to independent). In addition to running a highly successful agency, Kirk is also a nationally recognized speaker and author and has helped thousands of agents with their businesses. You can sign-up for the free webinar directly through our link here! https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_E9IrZDVtS_GhI0bMqroyMQ
